introduction: CAPK Veteran Supportive Services helps veterans and their families facing homelessness or housing instability. Intake identifies an appropriate program.
description: CAPK Veteran Supportive Services helps veterans and their families facing homelessness or housing instability. Intake identifies an appropriate program.

sections.who: Veteran status, housing situation, income and the particular housing program affect eligibility. Not every service uses identical rules.
sections.get: Services include housing support, case management and connections to essential resources. SSVF supports qualifying low-income veteran households.
sections.docs:
• Ask about veteran-service evidence.
  • Household income and current housing circumstances.
  • Any eviction or homelessness documentation available.
sections.apply:
1. Request intake

    Dial 211 or800-273-2275 as directed by CAPK VSS.

  2. Explain the housing need

    State whether you lack housing or risk losing it.

  3. Complete screening

    Discuss the program match, requested documents and available support.
sections.after: Maintain contact with the caseworker. A referral does not reserve a housing unit.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CAPK VSS. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is this a VA disability application?
It focuses on housing and supportive services.
Some programs also address housing-loss risk.
Does every veteran get a unit?
A homelessness-prevention and rapid-rehousing service for qualifying veteran families.
